replace_with_bnb_linear: replace nn.Linear layers in a torch model with bnb 8bit or 4bit quantized linear modules
dequantize_bnb_weight: dequantize a bnb 4bit or 8bit weight parameter back to full precision float tensor
dequantize_and_replace: convert a quantized model back to standard nn.Linear layers by dequantizing bnb weights
check_bnb_status: check whether a module is loaded in 4bit or 8bit bitsandbytes quantization
create_accelerate_new_hook: create a new accelerate hook from an existing hook preserving its initialized attributes
